description: Your Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind gain benefits. Flurry of Blows can spend 1 Focus Point to make three Unarmed Strikes instead of two. Patient Defense grants Temporary Hit Points equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die when you expend a Focus Point. Step of the Wind can carry one willing Large-or-smaller creature within 5 feet of yourself until the end of your turn without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
name: Heightened Focus
